about.body: 3rd-year Information Technology student (Japan-Oriented Program) at Da Nang University of Technology (DUT), with hands-on experience leading a full-stack team project (TaskNexus) and building an AI-integrated application (Algominds) with NestJS, React, and the Gemini API. IELTS 6.0 and JLPT N4 certified. Looking for a Full-stack / Backend Developer internship starting around September 2026 where I can contribute to real products and keep growing in system design and AI-assisted development.

skills.body: Frontend: React, TypeScript. Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, C#, Java. Databases: Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, SQL. Real-time & AI: Socket.io, Google Gemini API. Also comfortable with Git, Docker, Postman, and REST API design.

experience.body: No formal work experience yet — my hands-on experience comes from building and shipping personal full-stack projects, including Algominds, TaskNexus, and this portfolio, end to end from planning to deployment.
